sammendrag:
Using administrative data for the period 2005-2010, we investigate duration and
recurrence in unemployment benefits in Spain. The results suggest the existence of (at
least) three groups of individuals, each one with different combinations of covered
unemployment duration and recurrence. We also find that the impact of the economic
crisis has been to increase the duration and the recurrence in unemployment benefits.
Our findings support the hypothesis that not only the heterogeneity but also the
previous experience of unemployment benefit increase the expected duration in
subsequent benefit periods.
tittel: Duration and recurrence in unemployment benefits
